headings.text: 그 많은 사람 중, 너랑 나.

findings.message: 1 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.

findings.message: 3 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "광주" above "00:11"; "Santo Domingo" above "11:11"; "03 / 08" above "도미노"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Decorative index numbers: "03 / 08", "01", "02", "03", "04", "05"
findings.fix: Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 1 tiny uppercase letter-spaced label(s): "YEONSEOK LISBETH"
findings.fix: Prefer sentence case at body size.

findings.message: Emoji in the page: ♡
findings.fix: Remove. Use words or real imagery.

findings.message: 3 gradient fill(s): header.landing-nav.wrap → linear-gradient(rgba(13, 21, 31, 0.91), rgba(13, 21, 31, 0)) | section#distance.story-chapter.story-distance → radial-gradient(at 70% 45%, rgba(158, 83, 104, 0.19), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 65%), linear-gradient(rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)  | div.rd-game-sculptures → radial-gradient(at 50% 60%, rgba(50, 35, 43, 0.333), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 68%)
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 1 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: button.primary-button → rgba(12, 2, 10, 0.2) 0px 8px 30px 0px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 14 text-shadow(s).
findings.fix: Remove; fix legibility with a scrim or a different crop.

findings.message: Buttons with shadow/glow.
findings.fix: Flat fill, one colour.

findings.message: 12 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): header.landing-nav.wrap 1253px | div.story-hour-picker 689px | div.rd-game-stage 1267px | button 275px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: Yellow-cream background (text #faeee6).
findings.fix: Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.

findings.message: 4 typefaces in use (DM Sans, GiftSans, Gowun Batang, Georgia).
findings.fix: Two at most: one display, one text. Often one is enough.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 13px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: Only 2 picture(s) on the page (2 photographs, footage or raster images, 0 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 2 text block(s) under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The margins differ: 94px on the left, 50px on the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

findings.message: A section keeps its content on one side and leaves 1020px of the width empty: "Baby, 이번엔 이거 열어봐.".
findings.fix: Fill the other side with what the section has (its picture, a second column, the figure), or defend the void in one sentence.

findings.message: 1 stretch(es) of the page hold nothing at all: 748px at 8036px (the screen is 900px tall).
findings.fix: A fixed picture layer covers the screen here, so the DOM cannot tell whether the stretch is empty: check the screenshots. Close the gap: a section gap is 120–240px on desktop and 72–112px on a phone. Look for a min-height: 100vh on a short section, an empty grid row, a hidden element still holding its space, or a reveal that never fired. A deliberate rest is a placed picture or colour field, not nothing.

findings.message: The page has no visible h1.
findings.fix: Give the first screen a clear title in an h1 that says what this is (a name with what it does, the product with what it is for, the event with its date and place).

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "우리 사이, 이만큼." (screen 4, 100% hidden); "약 13,792 km" (screen 5, 100% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

findings.message: Pinned large text slides across pictures while the page scrolls: "Baby," (screen 3, 100% over a picture); "이거 내가" (screen 3, 100% over a picture); "만들었어!" (screen 3, 100% over a picture)
findings.fix: Jurors read a pinned title crossing drawings or photographs as a collision. Keep the pictures in the column the title does not occupy, or unpin it.

findings.message: The same large text stays on screen for 3 screens in a row: "Baby, 이거 내가 만들었어!"
findings.fix: A pinned element earns two screens, and something must change at each. Shorten the run or give every screen its own content.

findings.message: With reduced motion requested, 2 text block(s) on the first screen stay invisible: "Baby, 같이 놀자.", "같이 놀자"
findings.fix: Put every hidden starting state inside @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference); the reduced page is the finished page (references/motion.md §8).
